name: Konishi Yuu
source: Second youngest daughter. A kind and hardworking girl, she is quite enthusiastic about rebuilding her father's coffee shop, and was quite joyful after hearing about Leo's intentions of doing the same. After Yuu saw Leo and Ami having sex, she secretly became addicted to it.
